transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

What brings me in is... well, I just can't seem to shake this feeling lately. I feel like I've ruined things for everyone. I've been falling behind at work, and I've kind of lost control of the situation with my apartment. It just feels like... like I deserve whatever bad thing happens to me next.
Have you been feeling down, sad, or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?

Yeah, I have. Most days I just wake up with this... this flat, heavy sadness. It's like the things that used to reset me—putting on a record, cooking, or just tinkering with some electronics—they just don’t reach me anymore. So, yeah, it's pretty much there all day.
About how long have you been feeling this way?

I'd say it's been going on for about a year and two months now. It started right after a pipe burst at my old place. I was forced to move into this smaller apartment, and... well, all my routines just kind of fell apart. I've been feeling this way ever since.
Have you ever experienced a period where you felt unusually energized, elated, or wired, and needed much less sleep than usual?

No, I can't say that I have. I don't think I've ever felt wired or... unusually energized like that. If anything, it's the exact opposite—I just feel tired. So, no, I definitely haven't had a time where I felt like I didn't need to sleep.
Before this past year, have you ever experienced another period in your life where you felt this depressed or lost interest in things for weeks or months?
No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had normal stress or bad weeks here and there, but... never anything like this. This past year is really the first time I've ever felt this down for this long.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep, such as trouble falling asleep, waking up in the middle of the night, or sleeping much more than usual?

Yeah, my sleep has definitely changed. I'll usually just lie in bed for hours, listening for noises in the apartment. Then when I finally do manage to fall asleep, I end up waking up way before dawn. And I wake up already tense and just... exhausted. It really feels like I never actually powered down for the night.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or your weight during this time?

No, not really. I mean, my appetite is about the same as it usually is. I haven't noticed any weight loss or gain or anything like that. I still eat regular meals, mostly. So, no, nothing's really changed there.
Have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself, or feelings that life isn't worth living?

I don't have any actual plans to hurt myself, no. But... yeah, I do have those feelings sometimes. I catch myself thinking that it would just be easier if I didn't wake up. Like, if I just went to sleep and didn't wake up, then nobody would have to deal with me anymore.
